companyDescription: Social + Ads · AI — Facebook/Instagram/WhatsApp ad engine with 3B+ daily users + Llama AI. Huge margins, deep ad-targeting moat.
priceNote: fwd P/E ~20 — โตสองหลักแต่เทรดราคาหุ้นคุณค่า
summary: Meta pairs an elite ad-targeting moat and best-in-class margins with a forward P/E (~20) that looks cheap versus its growth. Reels/AI monetization and disciplined cost control drive durable FCF — a high-conviction quality-core compounder at a reasonable price.

catalysts.name: AI-driven ad monetization
catalysts.description: Llama-powered ranking + Reels/Business Messaging lift ad pricing and engagement — a multi-year monetization ramp, not a single date.

risks: Reality Labs losses remain a large cash drain
Ad demand is cyclical — a recession dents revenue

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Strong FCF and net-cash position limit rate sensitivity.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Ad auction pricing power offsets cost inflation.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Ad cycle is the bigger swing factor than rates for Meta.
macroRisk.summary: Low direct Fed sensitivity; the real cyclical lever is ad demand — manageable for a long-term holder.

valuationBand.basis: fwd P/E ~20 vs double-digit growth; consensus median target $825 implies ~47% upside

qualityScore.note: 3B+ DAU network effect, ~40% op margins, net cash; FCF dinged only by heavy AI capex.

dcaPlan.note: DCA monthly; add hard on ad-cycle or capex-fear dips into the Accumulate band.

technicalNote.note: Above a rising 200-DMA in mid-2026 — trend intact; pullbacks are accumulation opportunities.

thesisBreak: Sustained ad-revenue share loss or engagement decline across the family of apps
Reality Labs / AI capex runs structurally ahead of monetization with no path to returns
Operating margin falls below ~30% for multiple quarters

stopLoss.rrNote: DCA exits on thesis-break, not a daily stop

entryStrategy.verdict: Elite margins + moat at ~20x forward — accumulate monthly, lean in on ad-cycle fear.
